title: Hughes Aircraft builds the Glomar Explorer for subsea recovery

tellings.quote: you have things like you know, Hughes Aircraft building the Glomar Explorer

plain: In the 1970s the American aerospace company Hughes Aircraft built the Glomar Explorer, a ship made for recovering things from the deep ocean floor. Michels brings it up himself, without naming a source, in an episode about two days he spent with Bob Lazar. He gives it as an example of the kind of hidden project a private company can build in secret.
